decisions.decision: Retargeted 04.1's ROOM_CLOSED broadcast from room.players.size===0 to size===1, kept room-teardown timing unchanged (still deletes at size===0)
decisions.rationale: A live in-memory harness (RoomManager+ClientManager+bindBridgeToGateway) proved size===0 has zero real recipients by construction (ClientManager tracks room.players 1:1, so the departing player's own already-untracked socket is the only one ever registered at that instant); size===1 has a real, reachable recipient with no new tracking concept needed
